h_um.meaning: Liquid electrolyte film thickness, not rust thickness

parameter_contract.scope: Module-local declared names; numerical assembly uses separate parameter slices per module.

rules: source_symbols declares source notation, units and mapping notes; it never implicitly declares fitted parameters.

symbol_definitions declares acyclic executable aliases; expand them into registered variables, functions, declared fitted parameters and constants before checking rate, derivative, construction steps and global conditions. Final expression uses final symbols only.
Explicitly derive source-to-dimensionless mappings; never guess aliases or constants. Source relations without executable mappings belong in prose.
The full domain includes c=0. log(c) and 1/c are not finite there. No clipping, arbitrary epsilon or silent exclusion of observations.
Any alternative closure or change of mathematical form requires explicit scientific justification and new checking.
Parameter names do not prove physical identity. Each declaration includes meaning, dimension and constraints.
conditions are global feasibility requirements; local derivative signs and peak locations belong in trend_scope. Reference-condition failure is distinct from nonfinite response.
